scope: Sweep allocation failures through whole-operation AC1032 DXF writes containing a SECTIONMANAGER record, then verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: One live SECTIONMANAGER with three ordered section-object handles and explicit remaps for the manager identity, owner and every list entry. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Warm the writer, calibrate allocations with an existing destination, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, and check caller fields, destination bytes, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed callback readback of the manager and ordered remapped references.
